Backend: pytest across all suites (auth, rigs, documents, files, weigh-station, drivers, dashboard, phase2 trips/maintenance, phase3 deliveries/expenses/IFTA, phase4 assistant, cookie-auth, dispatchers) 70/70 pass (2 transient network timeouts under xdist re-run and passed cleanly).
